answer: Someone therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The opal counter is kept in falcon and jade publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1670 identities would post 802 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
